text:
julie: Opening a PR to add South Africa (za-south-1) to the regional availability table and to clarify embeddings residency wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/628
omar: Nice. Support asked for a short FAQ line: do Dedicated customers get in-country embeddings by default?
julie: Draft in PR: 
```
South Africa (za-south-1): Supported. Dedicated and Private deployments can be provisioned with in-country embeddings storage upon request (subject to contract). Hosted plans may store embeddings outside the country for some tiers; contact support for residency add-ons.
```
kevin: Can we avoid the word "logs"? Legal asked to use "data processing" instead. Also prefer "available upon request" phrasing.
julie: updated wording to match legal.
omar: SDK snippet please — current examples still use us-east-1. We should show header + client init for Node and Go.
kevin: Proposed snippets (short): 
```
# curl
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -H "X-Redwood-Region: za-south-1" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rwd-emb-1","input":"doc"}'

// node
const r = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':`Bearer ${TOKEN}`,'X-Redwood-Region':'za-south-1','Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({model:'rwd-emb-1',input:'hi'})})

// go (short)
req.Header.Set("X-Redwood-Region","za-south-1")
```
kevin: Also add migration note: clients using deprecated header `geo` should move to `X-Redwood-Region` (deprecated 2025-01-15).
support-bot: Suggest adding FAQ: "Are embeddings deleted after X days?" -> point to /residency/embeddings-lifecycle. Link-checker flagged that page earlier; use /residency/embeddings-lifecycle or link to support article if missing.
julie: I'll point to /residency/overview for now and add an internal TODO to check the lifecycle page. tagging @docs-bot for CI. :sparkles:
docs-bot: CI checks queued for PR #628. Link-check will run after label applied.
omar: Please add i18n-needed label for Z-A translations. Also cc @localization for priority.
julie: Thanks all — aiming to merge after legal approves final line and link targets. :thumbsup:
